acceptance: Mirror and drift machinery removed from develop: sync-results-data-to-published.yml, submission-validator-drift-check.yml, scripts/check_submission_validator_sync.py, corpus-drift-check.yml, scripts/corpus_drift.py, ci.yml sync step, seed-corpus.yml published-results ledger recut, nightly-v2.yml published-results checks, slim-branch loader fallbacks, and obsolete tests/fixtures.
published-results branch is frozen read-only (not deleted, preserving accepted-bundle history) with a README and CONTRIBUTING notice pointing 0.5.x users to develop.

Superseded tracker items (such as mirror-validator-submission-guard-standard-scales-20261122 and any remaining published-results mirror items) and superseded PR #4481 (if still open) are closed/dropped.
context: Step 5 of the owner-approved Option 1 corpus consolidation plan (2026-11-24). Must wait until after the core release shipping Step 3 and the corresponding benchbox-site release docs (Step 4) are live.
description:
## Problem
Once `benchbox submit` and the published site docs direct contributors to `develop`, the entire `develop -> published-results` mirror and drift stack is obsolete maintenance overhead.

## Change (Step 5 of 6 — post-release)
1. Remove `.github/workflows/sync-results-data-to-published.yml`, `.github/workflows/submission-validator-drift-check.yml`, `scripts/check_submission_validator_sync.py`, `.github/workflows/corpus-drift-check.yml`, `scripts/corpus_drift.py`, the `ci.yml` sync step and `published-results` rule, the `published-results` ledger recut in `seed-corpus.yml`, the `published-results` checks in `nightly-v2.yml`, the slim-branch stdlib file-loader fallbacks, and the ~30 obsolete test/fixture files.
2. Freeze `published-results` read-only with a README pointing 0.5.x users to `develop` (do not delete the branch; its history holds accepted bundles).
3. Close superseded tracker items and PR #4481 if still open.
